title: Add required* parameter in st.text_input
body:
### **Checklist**

- I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests.

- I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue.

### **Summary**
Adding a required=True parameter would allow for built-in browser-level validation and clearer UI signaling that a field must be filled before a form can be submitted.

https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Attributes/required


### **Why?**
Adding a required prop would benefit the development in several ways:

- It allows browsers to trigger native "Please fill out this field" tooltips and visually mark fields without the developer needing to manually inject CSS or markdown.
- Save the manual logic to prevent the form from submitting or showing additional messages causing re-renders.
- Allow screen readers to communicate form requirements.


### **How?**
Include an optional argument for required=True into the st.text_input() function


### **Additional Context**
No response
